extracted.intended_audience: Fellowship applicants and their sponsors/co-sponsors preparing a PHS/NIH fellowship (e.g., F31) application
extracted.subtask_description: Preparation of a PHS Fellowship Supplemental Form and Biographical Sketch for an NIH fellowship (e.g., F31), including required sections, sponsor statements, training plans, and human/animal subject reporting. Focused on completing the applicant, sponsor, and institutional elements to meet NIH page- and content-format requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch - overall format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the specified sections for each person and adhere to the five-page maximum for the biographical sketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch - NAME / eRA Commons / Position Title
rubrics_metrics.description:
NAME:  
 eRA COMMONS USER NAME:  
 POSITION TITLE:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List the person's full name, eRA Commons user name (if any), and current position title as part of the biographical sketch header.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch - Education/Training table
rubrics_metrics.description:
EDUCATION/TRAINING  
 INSTITUTION AND LOCATION  |  DEGREE  |  Completion Date MM/YYYY  |  FIELD OF STUDY
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide entries for each institution/training period including institution/location, degree, completion date (MM/YYYY), and field of study in the Education/Training table within the biosketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship Applicant Section — Applicant's Background and Goals for Fellowship (Training)
rubrics_metrics.description:
2. Applicant's Background and Goals for Fellowship  
 Training*
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the applicant's background, prior training, and specific career/training goals that the fellowship will support. This is a core component of the Fellowship Applicant Section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship Applicant Section — Specific Aims
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the Specific Aims for the proposed research fellowship project (standard NIH Specific Aims section).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship Applicant Section — Research Strategy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the research plan, experimental approach, and rationale. This is a required element of the fellowship application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship Applicant Section — Respective Contributions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document the applicant's and others' respective contributions to the project and collaborative roles (used to clarify author/contributor roles and independence).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship Applicant Section — Selection of Sponsor and Institution
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain why the chosen Sponsor/Co-Sponsor and institution are appropriate for the applicant's training and research goals, including institutional resources and fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress Report Publication List (for renewals)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For renewal applications, include a list of publications arising from prior fellowship support or relevant progress; follow the form's guidance for renewal-specific materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research
rubrics_metrics.description: 8. Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research*
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the applicant's plan for training in responsible conduct of research (RCR) as required for fellowship training; include format, topics, frequency, and who will provide the training as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor and Co-Sponsor Statements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sponsor/co-sponsor must provide statements describing their role in mentorship and technical guidance (e.g., mentoring plan, track-record of mentoring, how they will support the applicant's proposed experiments and training). The sponsor statement should document commitment to mentoring and relevant expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Support from Collaborators, Contributors and Consultants
rubrics_metrics.description: 10. Letters of Support from Collaborators, Contributors and Consultants
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include letters that document collaborators' and consultants' commitments, roles, and support for the proposed training and research activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Environment and Commitment to Training
rubrics_metrics.description: 11. Description of Institutional Environment and Commitment to Training
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe institutional resources, cores, facilities, and formal commitments to support the trainee (e.g., access to core facilities like HDX-MS, training programs, career development opportunities).

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Subjects reporting and related required items
rubrics_metrics.description:
Are Human Subjects Involved?  Yes / No  
 Human Subjects Involvement Indefinite?  
 Clinical Trial?  
 Agency-Defined Phase III Clinical Trial?  
 Protection of Human Subjects  
 Data Safety Monitoring Plan  
 Inclusion of Women and Minorities  
 Inclusion of Children
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer and provide required details about human subjects involvement, protection plans, DSM plans, and inclusion policies. Note: responses are taken from the Research & Related Other Project Information form — changes must be made on that form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals reporting and euthanasia/AVMA guidance
rubrics_metrics.description:
Are Vertebrate Animals Used?  Yes / No  
 Vertebrate Animals Use Indefinite?  
 Are vertebrate animals euthanized?  
 If 'Yes' to euthanasia: Is method consistent with American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) guidelines?  
 If 'No' to AVMA guidelines, describe method and provide scientific justification
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide required vertebrate animal use reporting. If euthanasia is used, confirm AVMA-consistent methods or justify deviations; these items are taken from the Research & Related Other Project Information form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required attachments referenced by the PHS form
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed required documents/attachments include: Training materials, Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Respective Contributions, Selection of Sponsor and Institution, Sponsor/Co-sponsor training plan, Letters of Support, Institutional Environment and Commitment to Training, Responsible Conduct of Research documentation, and Progress Report Publication List (for renewals).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assemble and attach the listed components as separate PDF elements per the PHS Fellowship Supplemental Form instructions; ensure each required element is present and follows page/format limits.
